description: A ledger of entries, paged: read the schema this deployment is on, then list entries a page at a time following next_cursor until it is null.

host.title: Ledger host
host.description: The host this ledger answers on.

operations.name: schema
operations.description: The fields this ledger's current schema has, and their types. Call this before listing entries, and again whenever a call is refused for an unknown field: field names change between schema versions.

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: One page of ledger entries. The answer carries `entries`, `total` and `next_cursor`; when next_cursor is not null there are more pages, and the next call passes it as `cursor`. Reading every entry means following the cursor until it comes back null. The field names come from the schema this ledger is on; call `schema` first and use the names it gives. A name from another version is refused with the names that exist.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Entries per page, 1-100. The ledger's own default is used when omitted.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return. The field names come from the schema this ledger is on; call `schema` first and use the names it gives. A name from another version is refused with the names that exist.
